title: Block access to protected pages before signing in
description: An unauthenticated visitor trying to open protected user pages is redirected to the login page instead of the requested page.

steps.description: Navigate to /profile
Verify the login page is displayed
Navigate to /checkout
Verify the login page is displayed

title: Sign in as a user and reach the user dashboard
description: A registered user can log in with valid credentials and is routed to the user dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the user dashboard is displayed

title: Sign in as an admin and reach the admin dashboard
description: An admin can log in with valid credentials and is routed to the admin dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the admin dashboard is displayed

title: Create a new account and return to the welcome page
description: A guest can register with valid details and is returned to the public landing page after the account is created.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill in the name field with a unique full name
Fill in the email field with a unique email address
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Fill in the password confirmation field with the same valid password
Submit the registration form
Verify the account is created and the welcome page is displayed

title: Return to the welcome page after logging out
description: An authenticated user can sign out and is returned to the public landing page.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the logout control
Verify the welcome page is displayed

title: Start password reset request with an email
description: This verifies that a visitor can submit an email address to begin the password recovery flow and see confirmation that the reset request was accepted.

steps.description: Navigate to /lupa-password
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Request the OTP
Verify a confirmation is displayed for the password reset request

title: Complete password reset with a valid OTP
description: This verifies that a visitor can request an OTP, enter the received code, and finish setting a new password successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /lupa-password
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Request the OTP
Enter a valid OTP code
Set a new password
Confirm the new password
Complete the password reset
Verify a password reset success confirmation is visible

title: Show an error for incorrect login credentials
description: A visitor entering the wrong password sees a login error and remains on the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with an incorrect password
Submit the login form
Verify a login error is displayed and the login page remains visible

title: Show validation when login fields are empty
description: A visitor submitting the login form without required credentials sees validation feedback and cannot sign in.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Submit the login form without filling any fields
Verify validation messages are displayed for the missing login fields

title: Show validation when required registration fields are missing
description: A guest leaving required registration fields empty sees validation feedback and cannot complete account creation.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Submit the registration form without filling any fields
Verify validation messages are displayed for the missing required fields

title: Reject a password reset request with an invalid email format
description: This verifies that the password recovery form blocks clearly invalid email input and shows an email validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /lupa-password
Fill in the email field with an invalid email format
Request the OTP
Verify an email validation error is visible

title: Require the email field before requesting an OTP
description: This verifies that the password recovery form prevents submission when the email field is empty and shows a required-field validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /lupa-password
Request the OTP
Verify a required-field validation error is visible

title: Reject password reset submission with mismatched passwords
description: This verifies that the password recovery flow prevents completion when the new password and confirmation do not match and shows a password validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /lupa-password
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Request the OTP
Enter a valid OTP code
Set a new password
Confirm the new password with a different value
Complete the password reset
Verify a password mismatch validation error is visible

title: Show validation when registration values are invalid
description: A guest entering an invalid registration email or mismatched passwords sees validation feedback and stays on the registration form.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill in the name field with a unique full name
Fill in the email field with an invalid email format
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Fill in the password confirmation field with a different password
Submit the registration form
Verify validation messages are displayed for the invalid email and password mismatch

title: Reject password reset submission with an invalid OTP
description: This verifies that the password recovery flow does not continue when the entered OTP is invalid and shows an OTP validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /lupa-password
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Request the OTP
Enter an invalid OTP code
Set a new password
Confirm the new password
Complete the password reset
Verify an OTP validation error is visible
